notes: Replayed on 2024-26, 2,469 games: picked the winner 67% of the time, the closing line 69%. The market was the better forecast.

Careful: DraftKings has Giannis Antetokounmpo at 28.5 points and prices the over at 50% (its margin taken out); the model makes it 35%. They disagree about his role or minutes, which is usually the model being slow on a rotation change rather than an edge. Simulated from each player's minutes and per-minute rates, with who plays drawn in every simulation, and priced against DraftKings' own line and price. Replayed on the 2024-26 seasons (about 45,000 player-games, nobody told who plays) the chances came out within about a point, once points, which ran three light, were nudged up. ESPN only carries props for games not yet played, so each line is saved before tip-off and graded afterwards; the NBA page's Record tab has the running comparison with DraftKings.
